compiled_state.description:
## Concept
Add a first-class research ticket type for durable, lifecycle-managed investigation work that does not modify the codebase and should not pay software-delivery gate costs. It fills the gap between ephemeral/session-oriented session_log records and implementation-bearing task, story, bug, and epic tickets.

## Proposed semantics
- research tickets use the ordinary open -> in_progress -> closed lifecycle.
- research tickets cannot be created in or transitioned to idea status.
- plan review is inapplicable and cannot be invoked for research tickets.
- completion verification is inapplicable and cannot be invoked for research tickets.
- file impact and verification-command metadata cannot be set on research tickets.
- research tickets cannot have a parent and cannot be made a child through parent-setting or child hierarchy links.
- research tickets may use non-hierarchical links to other tickets so evidence, discoveries, and resulting implementation work remain connected.
- research tickets appear in list/search/show operations and normal direct-id lookups.
- research tickets are excluded from ready and next-batch because those commands enumerate executable implementation work.
- research tickets retain comments, assignee/claim state, tags, priority, authorship, bridge-safe identity, and the normal audit history needed for collaborative investigation.

## Safety boundary
This type is not a gate bypass for code-changing work. The product should define and enforce that a research ticket cannot declare file impact, carry implementation completion evidence, or serve as the claimed work item for a code commit. Research findings that authorize repository changes must create or promote separate ordinary gated tickets and link them to the research ticket.

## Design work before promotion
- Define the canonical event/schema representation, public Python type, CLI/MCP surface, reducer validation, transition matrix, and compatibility behavior for older readers.
- Decide which existing non-hierarchical relations are allowed and reject every hierarchy-forming path consistently, including inverse link forms.
- Define whether claim is allowed directly from open and how default assignee/session ownership works.
- Define search/list filters and bridge/Jira representation without letting reconciled Jira hierarchy imply a local parent.
- Add cross-surface behavioral tests proving plan-review, completion-verifier, file-impact, parent, ready, and next-batch prohibitions and proving normal lifecycle/search/link behavior.
- Document when to use research versus session_log versus task/story/bug/epic.

## Intended outcome
Investigations such as architecture research, historical CI-log analysis, OSS prior-art studies, and empirical probes get a durable collaborative work record with an honest lifecycle, while implementation tickets retain the full plan-review, file-impact, and completion-verification discipline.
compiled_state.title: Add a lightweight research ticket type
